scope: REQUIREMENTS.md Part A §10-13: pi-review round cap and stall watchdog, pi-worker, skills contract, the repo test runner (packages/nana-pack, scripts/test.mjs) — 24 off-form origins
notes: Three merges, all rejected only when the two facts are separately breakable; here each is the literal same control-flow gate or boolean expression, verified non-separable: R-711 (revert vs re-review both reduce to `revs.includes(revision)`), R-718 (own-a-live-reservation vs expired/consumed/forged all gate on the same `if (!mine || reservationStale(...)) throw`), R-727 (refused vs never-runs both enforced by one early exit before runWatchdog). Three mutations (R-837 toctou lock-steal, R-721A tally-rotate, R-723A lock-dir) could not be run against the full 748-line review-ledger.test.mjs: each either crashes the harness on its own unrelated cleanup code (toctou, tally-rotate) or hangs it forever past any bound (lock-dir, an infinite retry loop that never reaches its own deadline check) as a direct, confirmed consequence of the mutation itself. Each was instead verified with an isolated, byte-faithful reproduction of the exact cited check and its boolean expression, run standalone, confirmed PASS at baseline and RED under the mutation; this is recorded in the mutation's own `break` text rather than silently citing the full file. Sibling-cite list, all three legitimate (same single test, two DIFFERENT, independently-verified mutations hitting two different disjuncts/branches of that one test's compound boolean, not one mutation copy-pasted onto two rows): R-831 shares R-702's only cite (`pi-watchdog imports no ledger or review module`) — R-702's mutation hits the test's `!/reviewShaped/` disjunct, R-831's hits its `!/import.../` disjunct. R-911 shares R-606's only cite (the one compound FAIL-line/WARN test) — R-606's mutation removes the WARN push, R-911's changes the PASS/FAIL label logic; both confirmed independently red, each leaving the other's half of the compound check true. R-914 shares R-615's two cites (the --self-test and NANA_TEST_SELFTEST=1 checks) — R-615's mutation drops a fixture (wrong COUNT), R-914's mutation misdeclares one fixture's expected verdict (wrong MATCH); both confirmed independently red.

merged.reason: 2 shalls reduce to the identical boolean check (`revs.includes(revision)` in decide()); a mutation making re-review earn a round necessarily also makes reverting-to-a-counted-state earn one, and vice versa — confirmed: disabling complete()'s `idx < 0` guard broke both cited tests at once.

2 shalls (own-a-live-reservation; expired/consumed/forged record nothing) are the same `if (!mine || reservationStale(held, st)) throw` gate viewed from two sides — the positive framing is definitionally the negation's complement, not a second, separately-breakable promise.

3 shalls (no worker mode; --worker refused; review never runs) are enforced by one unconditional `process.exit(1)` immediately after the refusal message in pi-review.mjs, before runWatchdog is ever reachable; removing that one exit call breaks all three claims identically, confirmed by the single cited test failing on exactly that mutation.
